text: じぶんに　きけんが　せまると　まるくなって　みを　まもる。

structure.jp: じぶんに　きけんが　せまると
structure.en: when danger closes in on it

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb says that whenever that happens, the next thing follows. きけんが せまると = 'when danger closes in'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く and adding なる says that something becomes that way. まるくなって = 'becomes round and'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: まるくなって　みを　まもる
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. まるくなって みを まもる = 'curls up and protects itself'.
